edition: Paderewski / Bronarski / Turczynski (PWM): model-reviewed pitches, attacks, rhythm and dynamic levels; not a facsimile edition
provenance: Derived from the pinned NIFC M. Schlesinger encoding, corrected against the exact local Paderewski Mazurka scan; source originals retained

verified_scope: independent voices on both staves and lower-staff clef changes
constant dynamic levels and within-measure pickup position
corrections: Correct the second small note to G#5 (not G5 natural) in measures 39, 45 and 47 to match the requested scan.
Restore the G#3 chord member on beat 2 in measures 29 and 61. The encoded first-edition second-beat chord omitted it; the Paderewski scan has G#3/C#4/F#4.
Include all 23 written small notes during import, including the extra G#4 before the paired graces in measures 39 and 47.
Replace converted source expression marks with reviewed p/f levels, Allegretto, poco a poco crescendo, poco ritardando and a tempo words; the p pickup in measure 8 begins at quarter offset 2.5.
Bound beam groups by voice/measure and quarter-note beat while preserving triplets, simultaneous chords, independent internal voices, LH clef changes and the final F#6/F#5 octave.
Preserve explicit tuplet bracket/number notation as well as time-modification values, so the reviewed triplet rhythm is visible in the symbolic preview.
